name: ssc-website-analytics
description: Secret Sauna Company website with analytics

scripts.//cloudinary:test: The responsive-delivery contract in .eleventy.js: the transform and the two preload filters must generate the same candidate list, a source rotation (a_90) must be tolerated AND carried into every derivative, and a hard-coded width must still throw. Mutation is built in -- scenario B removes the angle tolerance and requires the angle assertions to go red while the width guards stay green.
scripts.//models-json:selftest: The round-trip gate's mutation battery. Mutates real source files IN PLACE (src/_data/models.json, the saunas template, js/data.js), runs the gate, restores, and verifies the restore byte for byte. Run it after touching any assertion in models-json-roundtrip.mjs.
scripts.//events:test: Requires a sibling ../ssc-ops checkout: the stream-separation scenarios load the REAL shared tracker from it. Without it the suite fails with that message rather than passing on a stub.
scripts.//fonts:test: Group B drives a real Chromium against dist/, so run `npm run build` first. Static checks alone cannot tell you a font actually loaded.
scripts.//rhythm:test: Group R drives a real Chromium against dist/, so run `npm run build` first. A token's declared value and the value that reaches the element are different claims — and an edit (or mutation probe) made to styles.css WITHOUT a rebuild never reaches the measured page: it reports as 'suite did not notice', a coverage gap that isn't there.
scripts.//dom-subtree-hash: Measures the content hash a delete-subtree or add-subtree entry in dom-integrity.config.json needs. The config says the hash cannot be written from memory, and until this existed there was no way to measure one -- so the two shapes the config documents for ATTRIBUTE-LESS nodes were the two nobody could write. Usage in the script header.
scripts.//lint:css: The guard that keeps the type scale and the radius collapse from drifting back: raw font-size and border-radius literals are rejected outside :root. Six exceptions exist and every one carries a stylelint-disable-next-line with its reason.
scripts.//functions-gate:test: In-process refusal-path tests for the Netlify functions. No network, no build needed: requires the real handlers and asserts they refuse before any outbound call. Drives the advisor flag via ADVISOR_ENABLED_OVERRIDE.
scripts.//jsonld:test: Requires a build first. Parses every application/ld+json block in dist and rejects HTML-entity artifacts — the wrong-medium escaping that garbled the FAQ schema in production until 2026-08-06.
scripts.//lightbox:test: Requires a build first. Drives the gallery lightbox in a real Chromium: modal semantics, focus to close button, alt propagation, w_1600 upgrade, Escape + focus restore. Known limit documented in the header: no keyboard path to OPEN it yet (Wave B residual).
scripts.//csp-hash:test: Requires a build first. Recomputes every inline script hash from dist/ and asserts each is declared in netlify.toml script-src — CSP headers exist only on Netlify, so a blocked inline script is invisible to every local instrument (learned when the reveal-boot shipped blocked).
